releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.9 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Dual-Orientation Ad Screen Engines: Dedicated PortraitAdScreenComponent and LandscapeAdScreenComponent for vertical and rotated 2412x1080 ads.
* Complete 5-Subcomponent Screen Partitioning: TopLeft, TopRight, CenterModal, BottomLeft, BottomRight mathematically partition 100% of the screen with zero gaps.
* Dynamic Bounding-Box Regression: AdScreenExtentAnalyzer regresses active ad viewport (fullscreen, centered modal, bottom sheet) and normalizes coordinates.
* Hybrid Gate & Multi-Feature ML Scoring: Hard shield gate protects ad bodies, video players, and CTAs (Install, Download) with infinite penalty, while 6-factor scoring ranks real skip buttons.
* Adaptive Countdown Hold: Zero-touch protection during unskippable timers with perimeter-only micro-taps.
